notes.title: OUR NEW GAME: FORGE AND FIGHT IS NOW OUT IN EARLY ACCESS!
notes.content:
We're soooooo excited ( and nervous!) for you all to get your hands on Forge and Fight which is NOW LIVE, and we have a 15% launch DISCOUNT going on RIGHT NOW!

[b]But what is Forge and Fight?[/b]
[i]Forge and Fight is a wacky, and fun, weapon-crafting multiplayer action game. Each round, you are given random parts to work with to create as an effective, silly or random weapon as possible, to help you fight your way through each round against other players or bots.
[/i]
Outside of that, for those who have been keeping an eye on the game, we have a whole bunch of new things for you to check out, both in and out of the game:

- A new cinematic trailer!
[previewyoutube=6D4jE5ioJlY;full][/previewyoutube]

- A whole bunch of weapons to mess about with!
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/uo8BQnWZs1m6HR19d6/giphy.gif[/img]

- Sandbox Mode to create and test your wildest weapon dreams!
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/h4y6JQ9CsRpx5vcOCV/giphy.gif[/img]

- Cosmetics
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3C4bRsZ7VLWp20C8pF/giphy.gif[/img]

- An updated FAQ which can be read on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1066810/discussions/0/2443714202126949873/]Steam[/url]! or [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/flamebaitgames]Discord[/url]!

AND MOOOOOOORE.

Honestly, we're super proud to release the game to you all and can't wait to get all the community feedback from you to help make this the best game we can possibly make, and thank you SO much for any and all support you give us, it means the world <3

notes.title: Rage has been restored!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32613003/fd98bd25da33b6db4d94e63be9c8014b16bdab16.png[/img]

notes.content:
Minor update coming out today, specifics below!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32613003/3472c419437f951016e765a7ae1d92fa12bf54c8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Physics and leaderboard fixes!
notes.content:
Due to some weird physics interactions in a few levels and leaderboard inconsistencies we've pushed another patch!

[b]Here are the changes we made:[/b]  
[list]
[*] Made rogue physics objects consistent for each run
[*] The client will now be a bit more persistent in uploading leaderboard scores
[*] Cleared level 31 (High Ground) leaderboard as the top scores were unobtainable in the game's current version. Sorry about that!
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Hardcore Marathon update!
notes.content:
Due to popular request we have tweaked the Hardcore Marathon challenge to only include 30 levels instead of the previous 100. Hopefully this will remove some of the grind of completing all achievements of the game without removing any of the difficulty.

We also added some missing localization strings, huzzah!

Thanks for playing the game, and we're looking forward to celebrate the first Hardcore Marathon winner!

notes.title: Quick hotfix today!
notes.content:
We've noticed some issues that we wanted to fix really fast so we've just pushed a hotfix.

Stuff we did:
- Added maximum framerate cap, default is 120 frames per second but you can adjust it in the settings-menu
- Added option to turn on Vertical Sync
- Added speedometer due to popular request
- Fixed white thumbnails for community levels
- Fixed shinyness of objects in community levels
- Keybindings are now properly saved when exiting the game
- Added epilepsy warning to the splash screen
- Removed our favourite athlete from the level editor

Thanks for playing and keep swinging on!

notes.title: Verlet Swing swooshes out today
notes.content:
I’ve had fun swinging around New York this past week, but I’m ready to move on to somewhere more exotic. Pretending to be a super-strong man-spider hybrid with a supernatural sense of danger just feels so… tame.

Fortunately I’ve come across Verlet Swing, a grappling hook game where you hurl yourself through a fever dream of floating pizza slices, majestic goldfish and malteasers. The full game is out later today, but there’s a free prototype that’s well worth slinging through.

This is a wild departure from Passpartout, developers Flamebait Games’ previous game, where you play as an artist attempting to flog your MS Paint creations. I’d like to think all this takes place inside that artist’s head. (more…)

notes.title: Verlet Swing Beta Patch #3
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We pushed a small patch today to fix a few things.

[b]Here's what we fixed[/b]
[list]
[*]Palm trees now look normal again.
[*][i]Tutankhamun is no longer planning something shady...[/i]
[*]Excessive spam of restarts doesn't cause huge memory issues any more.
[/list]

[b]Known issues[/b]
[list]
[*]Extremely rapid and excessive spam of restarts can still cause minor memory issues and may even make the game crash.
[/list]

That's it for now, but we do have [url=discord.gg/FlamebaitGames]a discord server[/url] so come hang out and meet the team!

notes.title: Verlet Swing Beta Patch #2
notes.content:
Hey everyone! In preparation for our beta competition, we have pushed out our second beta patch today!

[b]Here's what we've fixed[/b]
[list]
[*]Memory leak fixes
[*]Leaderboards should now be even more stable
[*]"PREVIOUS LEVEL" button added to the pause menu! YAY!
[*]Level changes
[*]Some other quality of life improvements 
[/list]

[b]Here are some issues that are still lurking around.[/b]
[list]
[*]If you spam-restart a level, you will probably get a memory leak and eventually crash your computer, we're working on a fix. 
[*]Some palm trees have escaped the chains of space and time. 
[*][i]Tutankhamun seems to be planning something shady...[/i]
[*]Other stuff, please keep submitting bugs and feedback! 
[/list]

Our focus right now is to smash bugs.
No level design changes will be made during the beta to avoid meddling with the competition.
[b]
Leaderboards for changed levels have been cleared, other level leaderboards have been kept.
All challenge leaderboards have been reset. 
[i]Good luck and have fun![/i]
[/b]

For those who don't know, we do have [url=discord.gg/FlamebaitGames]a discord server[/url] so come hang out and meet the team!

notes.title: Verlet Swing Beta Patch #1
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Today we pushed our first beta patch based off the feedback we've been getting here's what we've changed!
[list]
[*]We reworked the leaderboards and they should be working properly now!
[*]We've done some game optimization and it should be less laggy now!
[*]The game's progression is now saving more reliably!
[*]We've made various level tweaks.
[/list]
Please get in touch with us if you're still experiencing any issues! Your feedback matters!
While we did reset game data, we didn't reset the leaderboards with this patch, so your times are still up for now!

For those who don't know, we do have [url=discord.gg/FlamebaitGames]a discord server[/url] so come hang out and meet the team! 
[b]By the way[/b], we still have some beta keys available. We don't have many left and they're first come, first serve! So join our discord and get in touch.

notes.title: Verlet Swing Alpha Patch #1
notes.content:
Yo! We have pushed an update for the alpha now, it includes the changes listed below. Also, we had to reset all the leaderboards since we made changes to the level progression, now's your chance to get the top time! (Sorry about that...)

- Added more levels to World 1 and 2
- Adjusted level progression, the game should now have a smoother difficulty curve
- Added world-specific marathon challenges
- Added universal build for Mac-users (looking at you Shnouk)
- Fixed bubbles launching you to oblivion
- Fixed issue with maximum mouse sensitivity being too low
- Fixed camera jankiness when starting level
- Added notification system
- A lot of minor bug fixes
